title: Realtime Combat (WIP)
summary: Work in progress: battles run on a realtime clock, with immediate enemy actions and overlapping animations.
description:
Work in progress. This overhaul is still being built and tested, so expect rough edges, balance problems and occasional broken battles.

Turns battles into a realtime clock at 50 time units per second, with immediate enemy actions and overlapping animations. Statuses advance on the same clock. Load it after character mods; see its README for co-load details.
